verdict.rationale: Composio's Triggers feature explicitly supports webhook subscriptions: users register a webhook URL once per project, and Composio POSTs signed structured payloads for events like new Slack messages, GitHub commits, or incoming emails, letting an AI-native app/agent react to real-time events. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of webhook delivery reliability, and no detail on subscription filtering/retry semantics.
